input: Draft a short pitch deck for investors

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Short Investor Pitch Deck
gold.taskDescription: Create a concise pitch deck designed to attract and persuade potential investors.

questions.title: What industry or sector is your business in?
questions.description: Understand the domain so the pitch deck content, tone, and framing are relevant to the right investor audience.

questions.title: What stage is your business at right now?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a pre-seed idea, an early-stage startup with traction, or a more established company seeking growth capital.

questions.title: How much funding are you trying to raise?
questions.description: Know the specific funding target so the ask slide and financial framing are concrete and credible.

questions.title: Who is the target audience for this deck?
questions.description: Identify whether the deck is for angel investors, venture capitalists, corporate investors, or another specific group.

questions.title: Do you have existing revenue, users, or traction?
questions.description: Capture any proof points, metrics, or milestones already achieved that can strengthen the pitch.

questions.title: What problem does your product or service solve?
questions.description: Clarify the core pain point being addressed so the problem and solution slides are sharp and compelling.

questions.title: How many slides should the final deck have?
questions.description: Set a clear scope for the length of the deck so the structure and level of detail are appropriately calibrated.
